bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/.worktrees/independent-chat-20261128
sha=231a8f47dc9cb566080ba9e69f758ed47885f073
base=sha256:e5802feac280f275c9591757bd76a0b215e711e6a534cd9d3dcdf579fddfb822
candidate=debug-ai-debug-ai:teaching-231a8f47
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test -n "$cid"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$cid")" = "$base"
git -C "$p" fetch --no-tags origin "$sha"
test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$tmp"' EXIT
git -C "$p" archive "$sha" server/chat/index.js server/chat/index.html server/chat/ui.js server/chat/develop-lane.js server/command-module/teaching.js server/main.js server/tests/interactive-teaching.test.cjs server/tests/chat.test.cjs server/tests/chat-access.test.cjs | tar -x -C "$tmp"
chmod -R a+rX "$tmp/server"
cat > "$tmp/Dockerfile" <<'EOF'
ARG BASE
FROM ${BASE}
COPY --chown=1000:1000 server/ /app/server/
EOF
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' debug-ai-debug-ai:latest)" = "$base"
docker build --network none --pull=false --build-arg BASE=debug-ai-debug-ai:latest -t "$candidate" "$tmp"
docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=64m,mode=1777 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --user 1000:1000 --entrypoint node "$candidate" --test server/tests/interactive-teaching.test.cjs server/tests/chat.test.cjs server/tests/chat-access.test.cjs
for f in server/adapters/ai-core.js server/adapters/chat-model-gate.js; do
 test "$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/app/$f"|cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$candidate" "/app/$f"|cut -d ' ' -f1)"
done
printf '%s\n' CANDIDATE_TEACHING_IMAGE_AND_COMPOSER_ADAPTER_PARITY_PASS
